descripcion: Segundo conjunto de VALIDACION: preguntas nuevas, escritas antes de medir las correcciones derivadas del primer conjunto. No se usa para ajustar nada.

preguntas.oro: SELECT product_status, COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY product_status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_marca) FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cual es la suma de las existencias de todos los productos
preguntas.oro: SELECT SUM(cantidad) FROM product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_status = 'en_espera'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_status = 'en_transito'

preguntas.pregunta: cuantos vales hay de cada tipo
preguntas.oro: SELECT t.incident_type_description, COUNT(*) FROM incident i JOIN incident_type t ON t.id_incident_type = i.id_incident_type WHERE i.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY t.incident_type_description

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el tipo de vale mas frecuente
preguntas.oro: SELECT t.incident_type_description FROM incident i JOIN incident_type t ON t.id_incident_type = i.id_incident_type WHERE i.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY t.incident_type_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nm_incident_product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND close_date IS NOT NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cuantos vales se crearon este anio
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND incident_date >= date_trunc('year', now())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND proyect_status = 'draft'

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el costo total de todos los proyectos
preguntas.oro: SELECT SUM(total_cost) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY priority
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND task_status = 'en_proceso'
SELECT task_status, COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY task_status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_customer_supplier) FROM proyect WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cuantas ordenes de compra estan autorizadas
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND order_status = 'authorized'

preguntas.pregunta: cuanto suma lo autorizado en ordenes de compra
preguntas.oro: SELECT SUM(authorized_total) FROM purchase_order WHERE deletion_date IS NULL

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el importe promedio de las facturas
preguntas.oro: SELECT AVG(total) FROM invoice WHERE deletion_date IS NULL
SELECT currency, COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY currency

preguntas.pregunta: cuantas facturas se emitieron este anio
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND date_emision >= date_trunc('year', now())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "user" WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND is_employee = false

preguntas.pregunta: cuantos usuarios tienen el rol de supervisor
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "user" u JOIN permission p ON p.id_permission = u.id_permission WHERE u.deletion_date IS NULL AND p.permission_description = 'Supervisor'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND expiration_date < now()

preguntas.pregunta: cuantos renglones de vale son de salida
preguntas.oro: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nm_incident_product WHERE deletion_date IS NULL AND direction = 'salida'

preguntas.pregunta: cual es el cliente con mas proyectos
preguntas.oro: SELECT c.name FROM proyect p JOIN customer_supplier c ON c.id_customer_supplier = p.id_customer_supplier WHERE p.deletion_date IS NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
